extracted.name: Mexican Pot Roast
extracted.description: This slow cooker recipe for Mexican-style beef is seasoned with green chile pepper, hot sauce, taco seasoning, chili powder, and garlic powder.
instruction_lines: Season chuck roast with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat; add roast. Cook until entirely browned, 2 to 3 minutes per side; transfer to a slow cooker.
Sprinkle diced chile pepper, onion, hot sauce, taco seasoning, chili powder, cayenne pepper, and garlic powder over roast.
Cook on Low until roast is fall-apart tender, 8 to 10 hours.
